title: Event envelope
description: Every event on every topic uses this envelope. The Kafka message key is aggregate_id, so all events for one aggregate stay in order. Delivery is at-least-once: consumers deduplicate by event_id.

event_id.description: Unique per event (UUIDv7); the deduplication key for consumers.

aggregate_id.description: Id of the entity the event is about (payment_id for payment and ledger events, case_id for case events).

correlation_id.description: Ties together every log, event and trace caused by one request.
